aircraft.source: Climb schedule and cruise/ceiling figures ANCHORED TO SKYbrary's published indicative performance data: Initial climb to 5,000ft at 220 KIAS/3000fpm; to FL150 at 300 KIAS/2300fpm; to FL240 at 300 KIAS/1600fpm; Mach climb at M0.82/1400fpm; cruise TAS 487kt/M0.85 at FL431 (ceiling). Mmo of 0.88 comes from a single secondary aggregator (aircraftinvestigation.info), not independently corroborated — treat that one figure with more caution than the rest of this file.
aircraft.source_confidence: HIGH for climb schedule, cruise speed, and ceiling (SKYbrary, a reputable industry aggregator, publishes specific altitude-banded figures for this type — the strongest sourcing of any file in this set). LOWER CONFIDENCE for Mmo specifically (single non-primary source).

climb.reference_condition: SKYbrary published indicative climb schedule: 220 KIAS to 5,000ft, 300 KIAS to FL240, then Mach 0.82 above.
climb.notes: This is the most directly sourced climb table in the reference set — band boundaries and ROC values below 24,000 ft come straight from SKYbrary's published schedule rather than being interpolated or extrapolated by this project. Above FL240 the Mach-climb figure (1400 fpm at M0.82) is extended smoothly to the service ceiling since SKYbrary does not break out further high-altitude bands.

cruise.reference_condition: SKYbrary published cruise data point: TAS 487kt, Mach 0.85, ceiling FL431
cruise.notes: 0.85 is directly sourced (SKYbrary) as the representative cruise figure at this type's published ceiling. Lower-altitude bands are interpolated downward using the typical long-range-cruise Mach pattern reported for the type (mid-0.84 to 0.85 range across independent sources).

descent.reference_condition: SKYbrary published initial descent: Mach 0.85 from FL431/cruise toward FL240
descent.notes: SKYbrary's published descent entry for this type was truncated in the source consulted (rate of descent value for the initial segment was not captured). The typical_rod_fpm below is this project's typical-widebody estimate, NOT a sourced SKYbrary figure — lower confidence than the climb table above.
